description: This file defines the 'RecordIterator' class, which provides functionality for iterating over records in large data files based on specified models and formats. It handles fixed-length and delimited records, supports buffering and stream setup, and manages hierarchical record structures.

classes.name: RecordIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for reading, buffering, and iterating over records in large files based on model definitions, supporting fixed-length and delimited formats, handling nested records and EOF conditions.

methods.name: RecordIterator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes stream from URL and model data file.

methods.name: RecordIterator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes stream from existing InputStream, model data file, and location info.

methods.name: setupStream
methods.description: Initializes BufferedReader with input stream and moves to start line.

methods.name: getNextLine
methods.description: Reads the next line or fixed number of characters, parses it into a record.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if more records are available.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next record, handling hierarchical structure if applicable.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the BufferedReader and underlying stream.
